title: Tiny, cute lemon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='lemonBody' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff9a6'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#ffe94a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8b800'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shine' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffef0' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fffef0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- little shadow for grounding -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#5c3d00' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- lemon body: rounded, slightly tilted oval -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='30' ry='26' fill='url(#lemonBody)' stroke='#d4a700' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- top nub -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='29' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f7d62b' stroke='#d4a700' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- bottom nub -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='81' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f0c800' stroke='#d4a700' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- texture spots -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='48' r='1.6' fill='#e2b200' opacity='0.55'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='42' r='1.8' fill='#e2b200' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='67' r='1.5' fill='#e2b200' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='65' r='1.4' fill='#e2b200' opacity='0.55'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='57' r='1.2' fill='#e2b200' opacity='0.45'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='60' r='1.2' fill='#e2b200' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- highlight shine -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='44' rx='12' ry='8' fill='url(#shine)'/>
  <!-- tiny cute face -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='53' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#3a2a00'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='53' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#3a2a00'/>
  <!-- eye glints -->
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='51' r='1.5' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <circle cx='57.5' cy='51' r='1.5' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='61' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ffb347' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='61' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ffb347' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- cute smile -->
  <path d='M 44 62 Q 50 68 56 62' fill='none' stroke='#3a2a00' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tiny leaf on top -->
  <path d='M 52 27 Q 60 18 68 22 Q 61 27 52 27 Z' fill='#5fbf4a' stroke='#3d8f2e' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M 52 27 Q 57 23 63 23' fill='none' stroke='#3d8f2e' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
